headline: Afreximbank Issues $81.9 Million Loan for Nigerian Tile Plant Expansion
summary: Afreximbank has provided an $81.9 million loan to Veenocks Limited to expand its porcelain tile manufacturing plant in Sagamu, Ogun State, aiming to triple annual production capacity.
why: Development bank financing supports industrial scaling and import substitution projects in emerging economies.

impacts.name: Veenocks Limited
impacts.why: Debt financing enables manufacturing capacity expansion.
